name: Adaptive-BIC order search
tagline: PC skeleton plus correlation-ranked initial order, refined by BOSS-style insertion using a sample-size-adaptive BIC penalty.
init_recovers: BOSS at fixed lambda when n/p large
diff_from_baseline: Versus the BOSS baseline this swaps the random initial permutation for a PC-skeleton + correlation-degree heuristic and replaces the constant lambda_value=2 BIC penalty with a sample-density-dependent value in [1.0, 1.4]. Refinement uses an exhaustive insertion sweep instead of BOSS's better_mutation rule.

name: Diagnostic stub (no algorithm)
tagline: Submitted code only prints the available local score functions and raises RuntimeError, returning an empty graph.
diff_from_baseline: Not a causal discovery algorithm at all: the function prints diagnostic info and immediately raises, so no edges are returned. Effectively a no-op submission that never reaches PC/GRaSP/BOSS-style search.

name: BOSS+PC ensemble with greedy parent prune
tagline: Two BOSS runs and PC are voted into a support score; per-target parents are then chosen by penalized forward-backward selection along the BOSS order.
init_recovers: PC + UC-sepset + Meek when p≤ 12 and n≥30p
diff_from_baseline: Ensembles two BOSS runs with PC into an edge-support prior, then runs a greedy forward-backward parent search with a support-augmented BIC objective. This adds a constraint-test layer and an explicit aggregation/pruning stage that pure BOSS does not have.

name: PC + BIC v-structure scoring
tagline: Standard PC skeleton, but unshielded triples are oriented as colliders by an OLS-BIC test plus partial-correlation evidence instead of UC-sepset.
init_recovers: PC baseline if BIC test always rejects collider
diff_from_baseline: Same skeleton stage as the PC baseline, but replaces UC-sepset collider orientation with a BIC comparison of {X_i → X_j ← X_k} versus the best single-parent fit, with partial-correlation acting as a tie-breaker. Meek closure unchanged.
